Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last month. We're close to finalizing our plan for 2029 and want to start the renewal conversation early. A few key asks from our side: 

- We expect a steady 35% increase in monthly token volume starting Feb 2029 (model usage for recommendation microservices).
- We'd like to discuss moving from our current 6‑month term to a 12‑month commitment if we can get a unit price improvement and an SLA tweak for p95 latency.
- Procurement will want a rough timeline for legal/PO and a copy of SOC2 artifacts.

Can you propose next steps and a couple QBR slot options so we can lock this into our planning calendar? Happy to include our Head of Procurement on the call (procurement@helion.ai).

Alex / Vanessa — quick pricing note to seed the QBR:

- Baseline: current 6‑month term (status quo)
- Option A (12‑month commit): ~6% off current per‑token price + monthly committed capacity to absorb the 35% growth with predictable throttling thresholds.
- Option B (12‑month + dedicated pool): additional 12% effective discount compared to baseline if Helion takes a dedicated GPU pool with a 60‑day provisioning lead time.

If Helion prefers an even shorter lead time for dedicated capacity we can explore burst options during the transition but that comes with a small premium.

DocuSign path: once we agree the MAPlan we can route financial terms and amended order form via DocuSign. HubSpot deal: HLN-2028-0521.
